items.q: And Eubie Blake and all of them, Noble Sissle and all of them talked about it, you know.

ctx.x: And the parallel like you say has happened all throughout history. Look at James Rees Europe who was around in the early 19 teens and the twenties, early twenties and they had to talk about Paul Whiteman who was the king of jazz. But James Reese Europe was the one that really was doing it. He was the one that had the 369th band that was playing jazz and went over there to Europe and just drove them crazy over there. And Eubie Blake and all of them, Noble Sissle and all of them talked about it, you know.
